scope: Primary documentation only; no interpreter/status request, road object, tool binary or routing result fetched. Search results from other publishers were not relied on. Documentation retrieval is separate from a future metered data run; exact HTTP bytes/attempts behind browsing are not claimed.

sources.title: Python Client
sources.documented: BBox queries stream from cloud GeoParquet and target latest via STAC by default. Reviewed options do not specify a hard total HTTP/request cap for these21 windows.
sources.designImplication: No new CLI/package acquisition or release auto-selection; pruning is not an enforceable aggregate transfer bound.

sources.title: Accessing the Overture Catalog
sources.documented: STAC discovers releases and GeoParquet locations.
sources.designImplication: A release/path and bbox predicate alone do not measure complete-window speed/access coverage or enforce our resource envelope.

sources.title: Geometries
sources.documented: The manual explicitly includes ways crossing a bbox without a node inside; node(w) retrieves their referenced nodes. It warns against expanding collecting relations.
sources.designImplication: Use full selected-way node closure, no cropped geometry and no recursive relation expansion. This is a documented query contract, not a live completeness measurement.

sources.title: Overpass QL
sources.documented: Documents named sets, date snapshots, child/parent recursion, meta output and terminal type counts.
sources.designImplication: No out limit or geometry crop; retain raw tags and typed IDs. Generator/schema/response validation remains a live-run precondition.

sources.title: Working with Museum Data
sources.documented: A way version alone does not determine its geometry because referenced nodes can change independently; date snapshots provide consistent historical combinations.
sources.designImplication: Bind requested UTC snapshot, every node version/coordinate and ordered dependency hash, not just way id/version.

sources.title: Commons
sources.documented: Describes status slots/cooldown,429/504 refusals and server timeout/RAM declarations. It discourages public production backends and world-scale bbox scraping.
sources.designImplication: One finite offline21-window pilot, sequential status/query pairs, no retry/failover; public instance is not a national acquisition strategy or app backend.

sources.title: Data Formats
sources.documented: Documents tags, geometry references, version/timestamp metadata and cropped-output limitations.
sources.designImplication: Keep raw response and full referenced-node geometry; accept variable nonessential metadata only by a frozen schema rule, never require editor usernames.

sources.title: Overpass API
sources.documented: Documents the HTTPS interpreter POST form data parameter and JSON response envelope.
sources.designImplication: Allow only the selected hostname/status/interpreter endpoints. Freeze actual generator/schema and received hashes during the bounded run; no runtime API access.

sources.title: Key:maxspeed
sources.documented: Posted speed limits can have default km/h units, explicit other units and directional/conditional forms.
sources.designImplication: Preserve exact tag strings; no inferred statutory speed table, scoped-rule flattening or ETA conversion. A source adapter needs a separate tested freeze.

sources.title: Relation:restriction
sources.documented: Restriction relations have type=restriction and typed from/via/to members; missing relations do not capture all implicit rules.
sources.designImplication: Retain parent restriction relations and unresolved external members, without treating their absence as driving permission.

sources.title: Copyright and License
sources.documented: OSM identifies ODbL and requires attribution.
sources.designImplication: Preserve source/license notice and provenance in raw/derived metadata; no derivative is published or deployed by this design.
